categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies the HTTP RPC server's request handling and authentication.
categories.rationale: Prevents unauthorized cross-origin execution of RPC calls using cached browser HTTP credentials. As noted in commit cbe4698cb5, 'After a browser authenticates to RPC, another page permitted to reach the endpoint may cause calls to execute using cached credentials', presenting a direct security and fund-safety risk for users interacting with web-based node tools.
